title: Join a drive-chain service joint
instruction: Join and retain the two chain ends using the yellow connecting link, blue cover plate and the two spring clips in the bench-mounted applicator. Leave the assembled joint in its service cradle, the chain seated on its guide, and both hands released.
context: Industrial machinery mechanics and millwrights rejoin conveyor chains during maintenance. This task isolates fitting a connecting link, separate outer cover and positive retaining clips to two chain ends held in a service jig.
setup: Two standard calibrated YAM arms and parallel grippers, overview and two wrist cameras, 1.10x1.30x0.06 m nominal wooden table (top z=0.7475 m), standard lights, floor and camera stand. Eleven nominal steel links, 100 mm pitch, paired 5 mm plates, 28 mm inner width, 12 mm pins and nominal 12.2 mm true bores; inner links 560 g, outer links 420 g. The service loop is immobilized by end nests and five visible tightened steel hold-down straps; ten fixed link braces and a fixed root represent that fixture. Fixed steel service bed 330x480x12 mm, top z=0.927 m, seven radial 36x18x12 mm former teeth and a 170 mm-radius hub. Loose yellow 300 g connector at (0.40,-0.35,0.8975)m, pins down, 100 mm pitch, 12 mm stems, C2x45 deg lead chamfers and 10.6 mm-diameter x 1.4 mm grooves centred 47.8 mm from the backing origin. Loose blue 160 g closed-hole cover at (0.50,0.35,0.8975)m, 135x35x5 mm envelope and two 12.2 mm bores with 0.5 mm entry chamfers. Two identical nominal spring-steel clips (each 0.4 g, 14.8 mm diameter, 1.0 mm thick) start loose in a bench-mounted 140 g stepped applicator with a hollow polymer grip, aluminium frame and steel pockets, root (0.310,0.030,0.9249)m, rotated 180 deg about Z. Its 50 g carriage has two passive horizontal guide axes (45 mm and 30.6 mm travel), a fixed 100 g mount frame, steel pedestal, base and rails. The guide fixes applicator height and orientation throughout the trial. Metal supports for the yellow link and blue cover, service-jig posts, clamps, bolts and all exact body/solid transforms are listed in setup-layout.json and scene-inventory.json. The finished cradle pose has the yellow backing above the chain and the blue cover below; either in-plane assignment of the identical pins and bores is allowed.
scoring: Current score: 0 after any permanent invalid-state/workspace violation, or if both connecting pins are not seated. 0.35: both chain-bush bore axes match their 12 mm pins, pin/bush axis absolute dot >0.9999, radial error at both bush faces <=0.15 mm and each bush seated axial error <0.8 mm. 0.65: both cover bores likewise have face radial error <=0.15 mm, each hole axial error <0.8 mm relative to the 44.3 mm nominal offset (including axial float onto the clips). 0.85: additionally one closed clip per groove (either identical clip assignment): centre radial error <0.4 mm, axial error <=0.3 mm, absolute clip-normal dot >0.999, both spring angles <2 deg. Full 1.0 additionally requires connector position error <3 mm and orientation error <1 deg from either symmetric fixture pose; connector, cover and applicator below 20 mm/s and 0.3 rad/s; applicator centre at least 25 mm horizontally from the joint centre; both grippers >=70 mm open and every robot collision hull >=25 mm clear; seven guided links with XY error <15 mm and height error <3 mm, normal-z >0.995. Captured clips may rotate around round pins; groove occupancy, normal and closed leaves must persist. All full conditions must hold for one continuous second sampled at 20 Hz; time gaps restart the hold. Each 20 Hz control frame checks all moving solids inside x=[-0.19,0.91]m,y=[-0.65,0.65]m,z>=0.7415 m. Other outcomes receive the greatest currently satisfied level; disassembly removes credit.
reset_notes: Restore the yellow link, blue cover and free clips; zero both passive applicator slides and the two leaf springs per clip. The guide mount, end nests and five hold-downs remain fixed throughout. Initialize standard READY/open grippers, then settle0.5s. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Representative 100 mm conveyor joint: 12 mm pins, 12.2 mm bores, a closed cover and two passive spring clips in real grooves. End nests and five hold-downs fix the loop. A bench-mounted applicator moves on two passive prismatic guides representing linear bearings. All fitting uses native contact; constant angular springs approximate clip compliance. Fixture and spring parameters remain constant throughout each episode.
scores: Dream-1 (dreamlabs/dream-1-beta): 0.0 in 4200 actions; scripted native demo: 1.0 in 3651 actions.
